principle: Source-first owner/boundary and user task value before further Element decomposition; existing System/Storage/Process/Hardware/Network owners are authoritative for raw facts. Future topics are not new accepted Elements or Functions.

userJobs: Find single-core saturation despite low total CPU
Distinguish workload from scheduler contention and throttling
sourceNeeds: Windows counter/API and WPR/WPA CPU usage and utilization definitions
CPU frequency, processor groups, SMT and topology applicability
topics.positive: Single core is saturated while total utilization is modest; distinguish bottleneck from claim of broken CPU
topics.negative: Total CPU=40% implies every thread has capacity
topics.unknown: Missing thread/core topology and workload evidence

userJobs: Why does an SSD feel slow despite high peak throughput?
Distinguish free disk space from I/O performance
sourceNeeds: Windows storage latency/perf counter definitions and permissions
SSD health/driver/firmware sources tied to exact model
topics.positive: High random-read latency at low MB/s can still delay launch
topics.negative: Sequential benchmark MB/s proves all app I/O is fast
topics.unknown: No exact I/O latency, queue and workload trace

sourceNeeds: Windows Startup Apps, scheduled tasks and service dependency rules
Signed package identity and rollback safety
topics.positive: Exact identified noncritical autostart item with measured delay candidate
topics.negative: Disable unknown Windows service solely from high memory ranking
topics.unknown: Unclear service dependencies or Product authority

userJobs: Distinguish crash from slowdown and compare same workload
topics.positive: Same workload with response latency and CPU/IO evidence reveals a candidate bottleneck
topics.negative: One high process Working Set proves app memory leak

userJobs: Why is performance slower on battery?
Distinguish thermal throttling from software workload
sourceNeeds: OEM sensor/power profile and Windows power diagnostics applicability
topics.positive: Reproducible frequency and temperature limit under stable workload
topics.negative: CPU utilization alone proves heat throttling
topics.unknown: OEM telemetry unavailable or permissions denied

userJobs: Explain video playback stutter or AI not using GPU
Distinguish GPU engine load from VRAM allocation
sourceNeeds: Windows graphics performance counter and driver/API documentation
topics.positive: Correct engine, frame-time and GPU memory observations under exact workload
topics.negative: GPU total utilization=0 proves acceleration is disabled

userJobs: Why is SSH slow despite a fast bandwidth test?
Distinguish DNS, routing, proxy and link problems
topics.positive: A high RTT or packet loss on chosen path with corresponding app latency evidence
topics.negative: Good bandwidth rules out DNS or high RTT

crossDomainGlobalObligations: Metric names/units and trustworthy time interval
Independent comparable workload and user outcome
futurePromotionRule: Each topic requires separate user demand, source inventory and exact applicability, Element decision, CQ positive/negative/UNKNOWN, independent SAP qualification and Product admission before DIS/Runtime effect.
